name: restart-service
undo: p=$(cat "{{.Dir}}/toyd.pid" 2>/dev/null); case "$p" in ""|*[!0-9]*|0|1) exit 0 ;; esac; kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true

name: restore-config
apply: rm -f "{{.Dir}}/toyd.conf.pre" "{{.Dir}}/toyd.conf.absent" && if [ -e "{{.Dir}}/toyd.conf" ]; then cp "{{.Dir}}/toyd.conf" "{{.Dir}}/toyd.conf.pre"; else touch "{{.Dir}}/toyd.conf.absent"; fi && cp "{{.Dir}}/toyd.conf.good" "{{.Dir}}/toyd.conf"
undo: if [ -f "{{.Dir}}/toyd.conf.pre" ]; then cp "{{.Dir}}/toyd.conf.pre" "{{.Dir}}/toyd.conf"; elif [ -f "{{.Dir}}/toyd.conf.absent" ]; then rm -f "{{.Dir}}/toyd.conf"; fi
